arStrings.szText: While you have {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c}, all incoming Direct Damage is converted into Fire Damage and has a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} chance to {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} you for {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100*Affix_Value_1|%2|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.

While you have {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c}, all incoming Direct Damage is converted into Fire Damage and has a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} chance to {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} you for {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100*Affix_Value_1|%2|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.
